description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/integral_lev_nodes_cumulative_from_bottom: integral(f, var: lev, lower: z_sfc, upper: lev_nodes) replaced by the rule's two-region makearray (the dz-weighted esm-spec 4.3.1 scan over lev on interfaces 1..8, plus the column total or the literal 0 at interface 9) (the cumulative integral from the surface to each interface). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLEV bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST in the esm-spec 9.6.4 reference-preserving form (the rule body's stencil references, the grid geometry templates the observeds zc and dz apply to the 9-interface array ze -- the cartesian_nonuniform_1d templates renamed onto lev by the grid's own import edge -- and the shared mesh/mms_column.esm test-column template behind ze all survive uninlined in the document's template registry), zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, the free-name geometry arrays surviving as index references and the lev_nodes axis folded to size 9. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
